summary: The patch correctly implements consistent ABAP indentation (indent and Format functions) in hir/abap, integrates formatting into all generation paths (emit, llvm, ts, tsfront drivers, wasm), and passes all existing and new tests. The implementation handles edge cases well: literals/comments/templates are excluded from keyword detection, assignment statements with keyword-named variables are correctly identified, multiline literals preserve their content, full-line * comments stay at column zero, and both operations are idempotent.
